title: 第十三章 坐火车去京市见家长。
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“死丫头，你还想做什么？”陈琴双手叉腰，眼珠子翻的就差上天了。

“我还能……”

这次，林栀才开口，沈时觐就没影了。

林栀望着他“落荒而逃”的背影，唇角勾起一抹极淡的弧度。

这男人的软肋，她算是捏住了。

“你这个死丫头还真是不害臊，大庭广众的就做出这种事来，你也不怕被邻居们说闲话，戳你脊梁骨。”

陈琴见沈时觐走了，恶毒的话张口就来。

林栀笑笑，无所谓道：“都说上梁不正下梁歪，我这可比你们差远了，你们做下的事哪里是不害臊？分明是不要脸。”

林大国听到这话再也绷不住，猛地转过身来，脸色黑的吓人：“混账东西，你还学会顶嘴了，真是喂不熟的白眼狼，当年我就不应该……”

话说了一半，陈琴就一把扯住他，冲他使了个眼色。

林大国这才意识到自己说错了话，用力拍了拍大腿，气愤地背过身去。

林栀从他们两个的行为举止里几乎已经可以确定，原主绝对不是他们亲生的。

她若有所思地出了屋，几步到了自己住的配房。

沈时觐站得挺直，朱顺跪在地上，鼻涕一把泪一把的求饶。

林栀故技重施，想从朱顺那里套钱。

只不过朱顺兜里没装什么钱，只有准备拿去赌的二百块，这还是他跟家里磨了好久才给他的。

林栀心想，如果让他回去拿钱，那个鸡贼的村长一旦知道了，这事就不好办了。

二百块说起来也是不少钱呢。她把钱直接揣进了兜里。

她让朱顺在同样的字据上签了字，按了血手印，这才让他滚了。

眼下，屋里只剩了她和沈时觐。

她满心想的都是原主的身世，既然她穿到了原主身上，就应该帮她找到亲生父母。

只是他们这家人肯定不会告诉她实情的，在这个消息闭塞的年代，她又该从何查起呢？

正想得出神的时候，沈时觐走到她跟前，一脸严肃：“林栀，我们两个好好谈谈。”

林栀想到刚才的事，当然清楚他要跟自己谈什么，她眼珠转了转，抬手捂住嘴，打了个大大的哈欠。

“沈时觐，今天太晚了，我也累了，有啥事等明天再说吧，你也赶紧回去休息吧。”

“几句话的事，耽误不了你多少功夫。”沈时觐想借此机会跟她把话说清楚。

“沈时觐，我真困了，脑子也转不动了，就算有天大的事，也等明天再说，行不行？”

林栀眨着一双大眼睛看着他，话里满是撒娇的意味。

"Damn girl, what else do you want to do?" Chen Qin put her hands on her hips and rolled her eyes.

"I can still..."

This time, just as Lin Zhi spoke, Shen Shijin disappeared.

Lin Zhi looked at his "fleeing" figure with a very faint curve on his lips.

She had grasped this man's weakness.

"You damn girl, you are really not ashamed to do such a thing in public, and you are not afraid of the neighbors gossiping and poking your spine."

When Chen Qin saw Shen Shijin leaving, she opened her mouth to say vicious words.

Lin Zhi smiled and said indifferently: "They say that the upper beam is not straight and the lower beam is crooked. I am far worse than you. How can you not be ashamed of what you did? It is clearly shameless."

When Lin Daguo heard this, he couldn't hold back any longer. He turned around suddenly with a scary face: "You bastard, you have learned to talk back. You are really feeding an unfamiliar white-eyed wolf. I shouldn't have..."

Halfway through his words, Chen Qin grabbed him and winked at him.

Only then did Lin Daguo realize that he had said the wrong thing, slapped his thigh hard, and turned away angrily.

Lin Zhi was almost certain from the behavior of the two of them that the original owner was definitely not their biological child.

She walked out of the house thoughtfully and took a few steps to the side room where she lived.

Shen Shijin stood up straight, while Zhu Shun knelt on the ground, begging for mercy with tears and snot in his nose.

Lin Zhi repeated his old tricks and wanted to get money from Zhu Shun.

It's just that Zhu Shun didn't have much money in his pocket, only two hundred yuan that he planned to use for gambling, which he and his family gave him after a long wait.

Lin Zhi thought to himself that if he was asked to go back to get the money, it would be difficult to handle the matter once the village head of the thieves knew about it.

Two hundred yuan is a lot of money.She put the money directly into her pocket.

She asked Zhu Shun to sign the same document and press the bloody fingerprint before letting him go.

Right now, she and Shen Shijin were the only ones left in the room.

All she could think about was the life experience of the original owner. Since she had passed through the original owner, she should help her find her biological parents.

It's just that her family will definitely not tell her the truth. In this era of limited information, where should she start to investigate?

When she was lost in thought, Shen Shijin walked up to her with a serious look on his face: "Lin Zhi, let's have a talk."

Lin Zhi thought of what had just happened, and of course she knew what he was going to talk to her about. She rolled her eyes, raised her hand to cover her mouth, and yawned widely.

"Shen Shijin, it's too late today and I'm tired. Let's wait until tomorrow to talk about anything else. You should go back and rest quickly."

"A few words won't waste much of your time." Shen Shijin wanted to take this opportunity to speak clearly to her.

"Shen Shijin, I'm really sleepy and my mind can't move. Even if there's something big, we can wait until tomorrow, okay?"

Lin Zhi blinked at him with her big eyes, her words full of coquettishness.
